    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y

  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    rw [hx 1, hx 0]

  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (h.trans (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (x k))).symm
  let E := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let O := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hp (k : Fin 2) : P.eval (x k).val = E.eval y.val + (x k).val * O.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq, E, O]
  change P.eval (x 0).val * ((1 - r_chal) * (x 1).val - r_chal) +
    P.eval (x 1).val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (x 0).val) = P'.eval y.val
  rw [hp 0, hp 1]
  calc
    _ = E.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * ((x 1).val - (x 0).val)) +
        O.eval y.val * (((x 1).val - (x 0).val) * r_chal) := by ring
    _ = E.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + O.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [hd]; ring
    _ = P'.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P', c, E, O, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, eval_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        sum_mul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro j hj <;> ring

  ⟩) coeffs

      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)

  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hx (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y k)
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    rw [hx 1, hx 0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (h.trans (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  set E := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set O := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  calc
    _ = E.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + O.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [hd]; ring
    _ = P'.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P', c, E, O, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        sum_mul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro j hj <;> ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  set E := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set O := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  calc
    _ = E.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + O.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [hd]; ring
    _ = P'.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P', c, E, O, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        sum_mul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro j hj <;> ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  set E := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set O := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  calc
    _ = E.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + O.eval y.val * r_chal := by
      rw [hd]
      generalize E.eval y.val = a, O.eval y.val = b, (x 0).val = u
      ring

      simp only [P', c, E, O, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  set E := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  set O := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  calc
    _ = E * (1 - r_chal) + O * r_chal := by rw [hd]; ring
    _ = P'.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P', c, E, O, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]

  set O := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs

        sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  have ha (a b u v s t : L) :
      (a + u * b) * (s * v - t) + (a + v * b) * (t - s * u) =
        (a * s + b * t) * (v - u) := by ring
  rw [ha, hd, mul_one]
  simp only [P', c, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  have ha (a b u v s t : L) :
      (a + u * b) * (s * v - t) + (a + v * b) * (t - s * u) =
        (a * s + b * t) * (v - u) := by ring
  rw [ha, hd, mul_one]
  simp only [P', c, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c P' y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  have ha (a b u v s t : L) :
      (a + u * b) * (s * v - t) + (a + v * b) * (t - s * u) =
        (a * s + b * t) * (v - u) := by ring
  rw [ha, hd, mul_one]
  simp only [P', c, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring
